name: ultimate-html-to-penpot
description: Turn pasted HTML into editable responsive Penpot boards.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names ui,plugin,serve "vite build --watch --emptyOutDir false" "vite build --config vite.plugin.config.ts --watch" "vite preview --host 0.0.0.0 --strictPort"
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.plugin.config.ts
